findings.detail: Action ResolverFilhoSelecionado skips the family_id WHERE clause when $usuarioLogado->family_id is falsy (null). This mirrors the pre-existing extrato carregarFilhos query on base branch 3db5a30 verbatim, so it is not a regression introduced by this branch. Not blocking; worth hardening separately if a responsible user can ever have a null family_id.

New pages loja/missoes and the edited dashboard/extrato use hand-rolled glass-card HTML with inline styles for layout (Flux is used only for toasts). This matches the established pattern of the base app (base dashboard and extrato already use the same inline-styled markup; extrato uses zero Flux UI components). The task scope was to move existing functionality preserving the current visual pattern, not to rewrite UI in Flux. Not blocking.

summary: All task goals verified against the diff (base 3db5a30...feature/extrair-paginas). The two dashboard modals are fully eliminated (no residual exibirModalRecompensas/exibirModalPlaylists/abrirModalPlaylists/exibirSecaoNovaMissao state, handlers, or markup). /loja and /missoes exist as Volt full-page components (routes registered with auth middleware) carrying the moved reward-shop and playlists/new-mission functionality, with modal overlays replaced by accessible page content (real checkboxes, button accordion with aria-expanded, no role=dialog/aria-modal). Child selection is URL-driven via ?filho= with the selector remaining only on the dashboard; extrato reads ?filho= and its own <select> was removed. Family validation is centralized in app/Actions/ResolverFilhoSelecionado, which scopes the children collection to the logged-in responsible user's family before firstWhere('id', ...), so a crafted ?filho= id outside the family resolves to precisaSelecionar=true rather than selecting a foreign child; a logged-in child ignores the URL. The /register header icon is present on the dashboard with title/aria-label and accessible SVG. AGENTS.md rules honored (Volt functional components with layout(), logic extracted to Action, pt-BR camelCase semantic variables, accessible markup consistent with the app). Verification evidence recorded in all four FEAT-00N.json findings and in commit messages (npm run build exit 0, php artisan route:list showing dashboard/extrato/loja/missoes, php artisan test); the 3 originally-failing tests were pre-existing orphaned Breeze scaffolding (navigation.blade.php referencing a non-existent route('profile'), used by no live route) and were removed per the user's opcao B decision, with no live screen affected. No blocking findings remain.
